role: a fairer local zero-shot baseline: choose each local Qwen3.5 model's readout per dataset on dev
claim: Two readouts exist for the local Qwen3.5 models: the prefilled index readout with a dev prior (suite_protocol.json) and the generated-code top-k tree readout under the hosted prompt (readout_lfl_protocol.json). Neither is better everywhere. This rule picks one per system and dataset from dev scores alone. Disclosure: it was written after the test results of both readouts had been seen, so the rule itself is what protects against selection, and it is the same rule readout_protocol.json used on 2026-10-08.
clinc150: Only the 4B has an index result on CLINC150. Its generated-code readout is scored on the CLINC150 dev split for this selection, and on the test and out-of-scope splits only if it is selected. The 9B is not scored on CLINC150.

rule.quantity: mean dev NLL after one temperature fit on that same dev split by the Program 1 rule
rule.choice: the readout with the lower value; a tie goes to index
rule.index_scores: the index score minus its per-option dev mean, as in the suite

reported: for each system and dataset: both dev values, the choice, and the chosen readout's test metrics with the dev temperature; the unchosen readout's test accuracy is shown beside it so the effect of the rule is visible
